prompt: Epic orchestral score at 64 BPM in D minor: aliens arriving, a battle of wills rather than arms; fear in the low half, hope in the high half, both at once in the climaxes

requests.ask: add a new song: an epic motion picture score, very large and orchestral, aliens coming to earth, not a battle but an emotional battle of will, lots of instruments, designed not chaotic, fear and hope at once

changes.why: bpm 64, D minor, seed 41: slow enough for one bar per cycle to read as a film cue
handchimes with follow off and a fixed 0 6 3 line: the alien signal never moves with the harmony
steinway theme rising by step to the seventh (a question), brightness ramping .3>.55 over the section
climax on i VI III VII: pedal organ bass, strings, quiet organ, accordion choir, chimes, tubular bells, harp arpeggio, recorder held tones, impact on the downbeat
D phrygian i II: didgeridoo bass, theme shrunk to a half-step sigh, chimes and bells louder: the alien will against the human one
F major I V vi IV: harp and recorders join, brightness ramps .45>.8, riser into the threshold
the answered theme ending on the root at level 1.2 over a low loud organ and a full bass: hope over fear on the same chords
timpani, bass drum, gong, cymbal swells, heartbeat frame drum, wind and space beds outside the layers, per section

requests.ask: do what is right: put the orchestral percussion under the axes

changes.why: sounds timpani, snare_low, triangles, sus_cymbal, bassdrum2 in place of the 808 kit: the only non-orchestral sound is gone, density, drive, articulation and weight now shape the percussion per section, and the fill before each climax becomes a low snare roll
timpani hits and the snare removed, since the drums voices now play them; the timpani roll, deep bass drum, gongs, swells and beds stay

requests.ask: listening notes: whistle too loud in void and signal; piano not real in approach and after; too much reverb in will; end too long

changes.why: signal textures wind .25>.1 and the wineglass .18>.1: the whistle was the wind bed and the bowed glass
vibrato removed for sampled sounds in lib/layers.mjs: the layer put a 4 Hz wobble on every melody, which is what made the steinway sound fake; only raw synths get it now
and brightness .6: the piano rings out instead of being cut at the slot end, and the 2 kHz lowpass opens to about 2.9 kHz
ramp .3>.55 becomes .45>.7 so the piano is never muffled
space: drums 1>.6, melody .9>.5, chimes .95>.6, bells 1>.7, organ .9>.6, strings .8>.5, bass .6>.4, glass texture quieter: the standoff is close and dry now
bars, its brightness ramps over 6, textures matched: the ending was a bit too long

requests.ask: listening notes: whistle still too loud in void, intro too long, piano pops behind presses in approach, contact and threshold, piano lost sustain in will, piano should be consistent through the song

changes.why: bars and its wind and space beds removed: only the didgeridoo drone opens the piece
.75>.5: the melody layer sends anything above .5 to a delay line, and that quarter-second repeat was the pop behind each piano note
.15>.05: clip 1.1 and a .3 s release so every piano note rings out

contact, will, plea, threshold, after melody: the per-section brightness, register, width and space overrides on the piano are gone, so it is one instrument through the song; only density and level differ
glockenspiel space .95 dropped: it doubles the theme and its delayed repeats sat behind the piano

requests.ask: the whistle you removed was wrong; trace what makes a sound at the void to signal edge that no single part has; piano still pops on key strike; will piano still has no sustain

changes.why: textures: wind and space beds restored, they were not the sound

reverb size .9 on every event: superdough keeps one reverb per orbit and rebuilds its impulse response whenever an event arrives with a different size, and the pads and beds carried four sizes; the rebuild swapped the reverb buffer under every piano strike and at the section edge, which no soloed part reproduces because alone each part has one size
notes 0@4 1@2 0@4 ~@2 1@2 0@2 and density .3>.5: each note now holds until the next instead of dying at a short slot, and no notes are dropped

requests.ask: right when the song starts it whistles; only with pad and pad2 both on; is this an odd effect

changes.why: strings sound psaltery_bow>dantranh_tremolo: rendered and measured, the void pair produced one naked 440 Hz line that each pad alone left faint and both doubled in phase. It is the sixth harmonic of the shared D2, the one partial surviving the 300 Hz lowpass. The psaltery sample map is an octave off and its strong third harmonic lands exactly there; the saxophone was worse; a tremolo zither triad has no line at all
and signal.pad2 density .2>.5, brightness .15>.3, register .2>.3, no octave drop: a tremolo triad an octave above the organ pedal spreads the energy across partials instead of stacking one

requests.ask: still whistles at the start; gone when a section is pinned or a pad is muted; different pad sounds still whistle

changes.why: drone didgeridoo:0 with note d1 > didgeridoo:8 at its own pitch: index 0 is a 0.7 s bark, and pitched down it is a descending whoop once a bar; pin and mute rebuild the song from the sections' layer patterns and drop the textures, which is why either hid it
deep space:0/3/5 > brown noise under 220 Hz: the Dirt space samples are sci-fi blips under a second, not a bed

requests.ask: the bark was the issue; undo the other whistle attempts; keep it from happening again

changes.why: strings back to psaltery_bow, void and signal pad2 back to their single low note: those were not the whistle
didgeridoo>didgeridoo:8: the same bark, pitched, was the will bass
the single-song check now prints a sounds block naming the file behind every sound:index heard, so a bark, a bowed cymbal or a blip is visible before it is called a drone

requests.ask: threshold crackles in real time; keep the section under the audio thread's limit

changes.why: width .8+ is jux, a doubled copy of every voice: the section ran ~49 voices at once and a trace showed the audio thread at 100% of its render budget; .75 is a pan sweep
the choir's spread was jux too; with both, threshold is ~37 voices, under the lint's 40

requests.ask: add a -mixed version of arc, arrival, breakwater, cutwork, hunted and machine without altering the originals

changes.why: size 2.6 fade .5 damping 4500: one hall for the score, each part's space as its send; the textures keep their own sizes (the outer .size(.9) moved onto them)
the impact was the mix (4.8 dB under it); now 12
the timpani pulse was 30 dB under the mix (inaudible); the sample is quiet, at the top of level's range it is felt at 21
glockenspiel>vibraphone the doubling was 41 dB under the mix (inaudible); a vibraphone at register .8 is loud (3 dB under the mix at level 1), so level .2 puts it at 15, far left
the choir was as loud as the piano theme (9 dB under the mix) and sharing the mids with the organ; darker, behind and to the right at 20; the organ keeps the low mids at 11
the bowed vibraphone arp set left; it still shares the mids with the organ and choir by the masking table (level-independent), left as the register already separates them
the piano theme kept in front (8 dB under the mix) with a phrase-shaped velocity line; the alien signal and bells right, the harp and recorders left

requests.ask: use the new mixing tools on the -mixed songs: impulse-response rooms, humanize, compressor, depth words

changes.why: synthetic>hall the generated hall (3.2 s, 30 ms pre-delay, damping 4500) for the score; the textures keep their own reverb
organicness .6 (dice per hit) replaced by a seeded, phrase-correlated feel (12 ms, velocity .1)
the pulse's organicness .3 replaced by a bar-correlated feel (15 ms)
threshold -18 ratio 3: the bells strike twice a bar, spiky
closer on the theme: weight up (.58); the piano's delay-line note in the header still holds, .32 is below the .5 line
farther on the choir: darker (.23), lighter (.42)
farther on the bowed arp: darker (.68), lighter (.52)
